$comment: Design context for 21st skills (21st-ui-explore / 21st-ui-build), written by hand because the 21st CLI is not signed in on this machine. Source of truth for values is src/app/globals.css; this file records them and the decisions taken in Shaun's section-by-section walk-through (from 6 Oct 2026).

stack.css: Tailwind v4 + hand-written globals.css (unlayered rules beat utilities)
stack.motion: CSS transitions and small rAF loops; Lenis smooth scroll on fine pointers; no motion runtime

commerce: Enquiry only: no prices online, no checkout. Pieces go into an enquiry basket (lib/basket.ts, this browser only) that becomes one enquiry at /enquiry.

tokens.palette_rule: Black and warm white, champagne gold as an accent only (a heading's key word, small icons, focus rings, the gold disc on pill buttons). No grey sections.

radius.note: Product photos sit in a 6px bezel with concentric inner corners (card radius minus 6px). Shaun, round 3: "dont make them so square".

motion.rules: transform/opacity/filter only; every animation has a reduced-motion state; backdrop blur only on fixed/sticky elements

constraints: Only S&L's own words and verified facts (content/*.json); no invented claims, ratings or prices
Product photos are S&L's own (public/images/pieces), no stars or sparkles on them
AA contrast; no horizontal scroll at 390 / 768 / 1440
Never touch the live site sl-jewellers-next or the BLA production branch

decisions.what: Services ('Bring it in. Get a price.') moved to /services with metallic-black pill actions; 'Shop by collection'; no starfield or photo stars; Visit lists every day with a black-and-white map; marquee heavier with dark edges and no gold.

decisions.notes: Utility strip (open now, address, phone) over a bar with the horizontal logo, every stocked category and a metallic Enquire pill. Sticks at -32px so the strip scrolls away. --hdr is 96px.
Huge numbered category words with counts; the photo follows hover/focus; shop links and contacts below. Focus moves in, Tab is trapped, Escape closes and returns focus.
The film with small corner type: what the shop does, the address, open now, a category rail and a scroll cue. Still no headline.
Shaun changed the wording to 'We sell gold, precious metals and watches.' (sections/Statement.tsx).
Watches as the large tile; slim text tiles for categories with no stock listed (sections/Collections.tsx).

decisions.chosen: A · New-in row, as a continuous marquee
decisions.notes: Shaun asked for the row to run as a marquee 'consistently going across the screen'. All 17 watches as product cards (Ask for a price, Enquire); pauses on hover, focus, off screen and with a button (sections/WatchShop.tsx, motion/CardMarquee.tsx).
Kept as built (sections/ServiceTiles.tsx), now with rounded cards, tags and CTA bar.
Kept as built (sections/PricesStrip.tsx).
Shaun asked charcoal or rich black; rich black matches the product photos' ground (~#0a0a0a), so the cards blend into the page. Charcoal showed the photos as darker boxes.
Shaun, 7 Oct 2026: 'genuinely terrible … so generic'. Replaced by three new directions in round 6.
Shaun: swipeable on a phone (cards follow the finger), no arrow buttons, an Instagram link (glyph + word, motion on hover) under it on the right (ReelsCarousel.tsx).

decisions.chosen: C · open now + week strip, with the black-and-white map on the left
rejected: A · Address + hours beside the map
decisions.notes: Map cut to the copy column's height, not C's tall photo (sections/Visit.tsx).
S&L's own stacked logo, small and centred; the cropped mark is no longer used there (Footer.tsx).

decisions.chosen: Stacked lock-up (crown and diamond over S&L jewellers)
decisions.notes: Shaun: the side-by-side cut 'is not the actual one'. Bar 80px (68px on phones) to give it room.

decisions.chosen: Centred list after Shaun's reference, photo on hover
decisions.notes: Every page as one large word in the middle, the others dim and the word's own photo floats by the pointer; hairline, address, hours, phone, bare icons (menu/SiteMenu.tsx, MenuHoverImage.tsx).
Strip, then MENU + two-line mark left, stacked logo centred, hairline Enquire pill right (Header.tsx). The menu mark is two equal 2px lines on whole pixels.

Exchange: S&L's gold Submariner (watches/10) across the Cuban chain. Sourcing: S&L's GMT-Master II 'Bruce Wayne' (watches/05) in a green Rolex box. Nano Banana 2.1, references recorded in assets/SOURCES.md.

decisions.chosen: The 3D S&L mark on a black stage at the top
decisions.notes: Shaun's original 3D logo (lib/sl-mark.js) via AboutMark.tsx: slow turn, drag to spin, tap to take apart; no stars. The About photo is S&L's own interior, upscaled, with the man at the counter removed.

decisions.chosen: Ending B · watch recedes, crest turns in
rejected: A · watch lifts away, logo rises
C · push into the dial, logo in light
decisions.notes: Remotion edit of Shaun's Marketing Studio film; CALIBRE removed. Kept off the site for now: Shaun is weighing selling it to S&L as a social advert.

decisions.chosen: C · Stacked stories, with five new pictures
decisions.notes: Three new directions on ?v=reviews: A The index (one review large, a numbered index of every reviewer, gold progress line), B Swing tags (each review on an ivory jeweller's tag in a pile you flick through), C Stacked stories (five reviews beside photos from S&L's own case, cards stacking on scroll; captioned as stock, not the reviewers' pieces). Quotes stay word for word; Google and Facebook figures side by side, never averaged.
Shaun moved '(01) Gold, watches and bullion, bought and sold over the counter' to the bottom left, aligned with MENU (HeroCorners.tsx, .hero-b-bl).

decisions.chosen: White type, green dot when open
decisions.notes: Header strip and Visit (OpenNowChip.tsx, .chip.is-open in globals.css). Closed stays grey.

Nothing is listed in either category, so each gets a cover illustration (content/collections.json 'cover'), captioned 'Ask what is in', on the homepage bento and /pieces. Replace with a real photo once S&L list one.

decisions.chosen: pending (A · Expanding panels shows by default)
decisions.notes: ?v=pieces: A expanding panels (tall slices, the one under the pointer opens), B film strip (pinned, scroll slides the frames sideways; a swipe row on phones), C lit cards (tilt toward the pointer with a moving light, plus a 'Not listed?' tile). components/pages/Pieces*.tsx

decisions.chosen: pending (A · Hero and case shows by default)
decisions.notes: ?v=cat: A hero band with the lead piece and a product card grid, B showcase rows (one piece per row, alternating), C stock list with a held preview photo. Empty categories show the cover and 'The case changes daily'. components/pages/Category*.tsx

decisions.section: product pages and the enquiry basket
decisions.chosen: Every piece gets its own page; a basket that becomes one enquiry
rejected: Cards going straight to the enquiry form
decisions.notes: Shaun: 'an actual product page ... just without the Buy now', with a basket and Enquire. /pieces/<category>/<title-slug>-<hash> (lib/piece-url.ts). Layout: B Stage picked (full black stage under the name set huge, sticky bar with the actions; ProductStage.tsx) over A store with loupe zoom and C details beside the photo with two crops. Basket: lib/basket.ts (this browser only, no prices, no checkout), bag in the header, drawer, 'Enquire about these' fills the enquiry form (?basket=1).

rejected: B · What's it about (six photo tiles)
C · A note to the shop (ivory stationery)
decisions.notes: Shaun: the contact page was 'very generic and bad'; then 'use enquiry a'. The shop's own photo with the open-now chip, four contact pills (call, WhatsApp, email, directions) and the form on a dark card. pages/EnquiryLayouts.tsx (EnquiryCounter), pages/enquiry-parts.tsx (ContactPills).

decisions.chosen: C · Chat with the counter (Shaun's pick)
decisions.notes: Shaun: the old form's 'UI/UX design is terrible'; then 'use form 3' / 'form C'. The shop asks one thing at a time in message bubbles (subject chips, message, optional photos, name, phone, email, reply method, consent and send), answers become the visitor's own bubbles and can be tapped to change, a short typing pause before each question that reduced motion skips. After 21st's chat composers. components/enquiry/FormChat.tsx on the hook useEnquiry.ts (values, the server's field checks, Turnstile, honeypot, POST) and parts.tsx. A server-side field error jumps back to the question that holds it. Arriving from the basket lists the pieces as the visitor's first bubble. Rejected: A four steps under a numbered rail; B one page with floating labels and a sticky Send bar. Figma was not connected in this session, so the references were 21st.dev patterns.

decisions.chosen: Black and white, no gold on controls
rejected: Gold gradient buttons, chips and bubbles
decisions.notes: Shaun: 'keep it black and white', 'get rid of the gold accents on buttons etc', while the gold in display type ('the case.') stays. White plates with black type for primary actions; black with a white rim once something is in the basket. Whether buttons should stay pills at all is the next round (square plate / hairline link / case-edge).

rejected: Fixed Call / WhatsApp / Directions bar on phones
decisions.notes: Shaun: 'why is this there on mobile', 'literally remove it'. StickyBar.tsx deleted; the hero line, film toggle and product bar no longer sit 56px up.

decisions.section: enquiry page: ways to reach the shop
decisions.notes: Shaun on the four stacked contact pills: 'i dont know if i like this'. ?v=contact: A ledger (hairline rows, small label, the detail set large, an arrow that lifts), B the card (the details set like S&L's printed card with square Call and WhatsApp below), C the number (the phone number set huge as the thing to tap, WhatsApp / Email / Directions in a ruled row). Black and white only. pages/enquiry-parts.tsx. Then Shaun: 'we dont need any for that, its literally in the footer'. The block is gone; the side panel keeps the heading, the shop photo with the open-now chip and the enquiries note.

decisions.chosen: Black glass with Oyster steel (Shaun's pick)
rejected: Round one B · Hairline (links on a line)
Round two A · Oyster steel alone
Round two B · Black glass alone
decisions.notes: Shaun: 'do you think this design of website should have these pilled buttons, or different so it fits the vibe'. Recommended square plates for main actions and hairline links for secondary ones. ?v=btn: A plate (square, solid white for the main action, hairline outline otherwise), B hairline (no boxes, tracked capitals on a line that wipes through on hover), C corner marks (four fine corner brackets like a jeweller's tag, filling white on hover). Covers the header Enquire, Add to basket, Send and Continue, the service buttons, Pause, the site's .btn-metal / .btn-ghost; chips lose the pill in all three, chat bubbles stay round. One CSS block at the end of globals.css keyed on html[data-x-btn]; when one is picked, fold it into the base rules and delete the others. Shaun turned all three down ('i dont like any of them') and chose 'three new styles'. Round two, after 21st.dev's Metallic Button, Shiny Button and Magnetic Button: A Oyster steel (brushed steel main action with a light sweep, black with a polished chrome rim for the rest), B black glass (rim and surface light up under the cursor), C magnetic (solid white, outline for the rest, drifts toward the cursor and springs back). CSS block at the end of globals.css plus components/motion/ButtonFX.tsx for the pointer. Shaun: 'black glass with oyster steel'. The main action on a page (Add to basket, Send, Continue) is polished Oyster steel with black type and a light sweep on hover; every other button is black glass on a polished steel rim that lights up under the cursor; icon discs are steel. Then 'why does this look like it has lines on' (the brushed grain, removed) and 'the buttons are too large' (44px main, 40px the rest, 30px discs). The switch is gone; one block at the end of globals.css, pointer in components/motion/ButtonFX.tsx.
